objective: Multiply two 8-bit numbers using repeated addition.
theory: Since 8085 lacks a hardware MUL instruction, multiplication (A x B) is implemented by adding A to itself B times.
algorithm: 1. Load multiplicand into B and multiplier into C.
assembly_code:
LDA 2050H   ; Load multiplicand
MOV B, A
LDA 2051H   ; Load multiplier
MOV C, A
MVI A, 00H  ; Clear product accumulator
LOOP: ADD B ; Add multiplicand
DCR C       ; Decrement counter
JNZ LOOP    ; Repeat
STA 2052H   ; Store product
HLT
